parameters.name: CoverURL
parameters.description: The thumbnail of the online editing project. If this parameter is left empty and the video track on the timeline already contains materials, the thumbnail of the first material on the timeline is used by default.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the online editing project.

parameters.name: Timeline
parameters.description:
The timeline of the online editing project. JSON format. For the specific structure definition, see [Timeline](~~52839~~).

If this parameter is left empty, an empty timeline is created and the total duration of the online editing project is 0.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The title of the online editing project.
